scenes.title: The Art of War
scenes.summary: Arkady's surreal dream about Lyolya and Marina is interrupted at dawn by Samson, who finished reading Machiavelli's The Prince for his diction and asks what to read next; Arkady recommends Sun Tzu's The Art of War. Opening song.

scenes.title: Debt canceled
scenes.summary: Bruised debt collectors Uncle Grisha and Kostik apologize to Marina at her door, hand her flowers and a notice that her microloan debt is completely canceled, and pass along a romantic message from Eduard Valentinovich.

scenes.title: Cappuccino with cinnamon
scenes.summary: Samson's teenage daughter Yulya secretly works as a waitress at a restaurant where Pasha Osipenko tries to reassure sceptical local businessmen about the cluster project and fusses over his cappuccino with cinnamon.

scenes.title: Honest election
scenes.summary: Election commission chairwoman Irina Petrovna informs Pasha that Moscow ordered the Sineozersk election to be conducted with complete honesty because Samsonov is a celebrity; the businessmen pull out of the cluster until Pasha's victory is guaranteed, giving Pasha a hypertensive crisis.

scenes.title: Orphan girl story
scenes.summary: Yulya also works serving coffee to meatpacking plant owner Veniamin Igorevich Ignatyev, who believes her invented story that she is a tragic orphan caring for a sick grandmother; Ignatyev kicks out cynical buyer Vasya and gives Yulya extra money.

scenes.title: Interfering in the election
scenes.summary: On a video call with General Kruglov, Major Lavrov reports Samsonov's rising popularity and Pasha's hypertensive crisis, and receives Kruglov's permission to discredit the people's candidate.

scenes.title: Panda beaten with bamboo
scenes.summary: Lyolya hangs up on Arkady when he demands she visit, and Ilona tells Arkady that every businessman in town has refused to fund Samsonov's campaign except meatpacking plant owner Ignatyev, who hates both Arkady and Osipenko.

scenes.title: Condensed milk cake
scenes.summary: Marina tries to break up with Eduard on the phone, but he lies that he has just told his wife Alla Evgenyevna everything about them and asks Marina to bake his favorite condensed milk cake for tonight.

scenes.title: Not quite a child
scenes.summary: Finding zero dirt in Samsonov's file, Lavrov and Ovechkin eye diminutive Lieutenant Lyova Sokolov as a fake child whom Samsonov might hit on camera, but Lyova and his uncle Colonel Mikhail Mikhailovich furiously refuse.

scenes.title: Calling Yulya's bluff
scenes.summary: Ilona arrives at the meatpacking plant and catches Yulya working there instead of attending school; checking Yulya's pulse to call her bluff, Ilona learns Yulya is saving money to run away to Moscow and become an actress.

scenes.title: Starting with the laundry
scenes.summary: As Marina takes Lyosha to Grandma Lyuba's before Eduard's visit and refuses to lend Arkady five thousand roubles, neighbor Klavdia Viktorovna offers to pay Arkady the five thousand if he earns it by doing housework for her.

scenes.title: Ignatyev's weak spot
scenes.summary: Ignatyev proudly serves Ilona his local delicacies but refuses to fund Samsonov's campaign; outside, Yulya tips Ilona off about Ignatyev's one weak spot — his estranged vegetarian ballerina daughter Galina.

scenes.title: Follow your sister's example
scenes.summary: Summoned to school over Slavik's prank collage of English teacher Inga Evgenyevna, Samson and Nina are shocked when the principal asks how Yulya is recovering after two weeks in the regional hospital.

scenes.title: Provoking Samsonov
scenes.summary: Behind Colonel Mikhail Mikhailovich's back, Lavrov and Ovechkin persuade Lieutenant Lyova Sokolov to dress up in a schoolboy's jacket and provoke Samsonov on camera.

scenes.title: The word pedicure
scenes.summary: Arkady scrubs Klavdia Viktorovna's Yugoslavian laundry by hand and strains his back, Marina sets a can of condensed milk to boil on the stove, and Klavdia Viktorovna demands that Arkady give her a pedicure next.

scenes.title: Chronic library debtor
scenes.summary: Samson checks out Sun Tzu's The Art of War from the strict city librarian, who scolds him for never returning Nosov's Neznaika borrowed in 1984; outside, Lavrov confiscates disguised Lyova's pistol and sends him after Samson.

scenes.title: Ambush on the bridge
scenes.summary: On the park footbridge Lyova insults Samsonov and tries to snatch his library book while Lavrov films; when Samsonov calls him a dwarf, enraged Lyova leaps at him, misses, and falls over the railing into the icy river, forcing Samsonov to dive in and rescue him.

scenes.title: Tying a broom to a mop
scenes.summary: After finishing Klavdia Viktorovna's pedicure, Arkady is ordered to knock neighbor's trash off a tree branch outside the kitchen window with a broom tied to a mop, while soaked Samson and Nina scold Slavik and rush out to find Yulya.

scenes.title: Stage fright
scenes.summary: Visiting the ballet studio ahead of the Moscow audition, Ilona learns from the choreographer that Ignatyev's daughter Galina freezes like wood on stage from stage fright; meanwhile Ignatyev drives Yulya home through a snowstorm.

scenes.title: A calm talk
scenes.summary: Yulya brags to classmate Kapustina that meatpacking plant owner Ignatyev is buying her a car; inside, Nina finds Yulya's hidden stack of cash, blows up at her, and drives Yulya to run away in tears.

scenes.title: Exploding condensed milk
scenes.summary: Arkady climbs onto the kitchen windowsill with his broom-and-mop pole while Slavik holds his leg, but Marina's forgotten can of condensed milk explodes on the stove and sends Arkady tumbling out the window into the snow just as Samson questions Kapustina in the courtyard.

scenes.title: I fell out the window
scenes.summary: Warned by the FSIN officer not to leave the flat perimeter again, snow-covered Arkady limps upstairs and demands his five thousand roubles from Klavdia Viktorovna, who flatly claims she is a poor pensioner with no money.

scenes.title: Competitive anger
scenes.summary: After promising Nina to track Yulya's phone via social media, Ilona uses reverse psychology on Galina Ignatyeva backstage — insulting her dancing to spark her competitive anger right as she is called onto the stage.

scenes.title: Cake with jam
scenes.summary: Fired up by Ilona's insult, Galina dances brilliantly at the audition, while back at the communal flat Marina brings bruised Arkady a slice of cake made with jam instead of the exploded condensed milk.

scenes.title: Exaggerated a little
scenes.summary: During their candlelit date Eduard gets a phone call from his wife Alla Evgenyevna, whose flight was canceled due to food poisoning; realizing Eduard lied about telling his wife, Marina watches coldly as he admits he exaggerated and sprints out.

scenes.title: Exposing Yulya's lies
scenes.summary: Yulya asks Ignatyev for 157,600 roubles for her grandmother's fake surgery and claims the man at the gate is her abusive ex-boyfriend; Samson punches Ignatyev, and when Yulya, Nina, and Ilona run out, all of Yulya's lies are exposed.

scenes.title: A real mayor today
scenes.summary: Arkady comes to heartbroken Marina's room for another slice of jam cake, stays to drink champagne and cheer her up, and gullibly falls for her deadpan joke that her red-haired son Lyosha's father is the redhead from Ivanushki.

scenes.title: At least he loves his daughter
scenes.summary: Having passed the Moscow ballet audition thanks to Ilona, Galina reconciles with her father Ignatyev and persuades him to fund Samsonov's election campaign.

scenes.title: Bulgarian rakia
scenes.summary: After laughing over a game of cards, Arkady and Marina move to his room to drink a small bottle of Bulgarian rakia gifted by Marina's students — just as the doorbell rings twice for Arkady.

scenes.title: The moment has passed
scenes.summary: Lyolya arrives to visit Arkady, who stops her from undressing, gives her Chanel perfume, and walks her out so he can return to Marina, but Marina coolly tells him the moment has passed and closes her door.

scenes.title: People's hero Ivan Samsonov
scenes.summary: TV news hails Samsonov as a hero for rescuing a drowning boy from the river, Colonel Mikhail Mikhailovich furiously scolds Lavrov and Ovechkin after his nephew Lyova comes home drunk on rubbing alcohol, and Samson and Nina warmly hug Yulya at home.
